props.name: mask
props.label: mask
props.description:
Mask spec — built-in preset key (`'phone:fr'`, …), a
raw pattern (`'(##) ###-####'`) or a full options object.
When set, `v-model` exposes the UNMASKED value; the DOM
input displays the formatted (masked) string.

props.name: error
props.label: error
props.description:
Error state for the field.
  - `boolean` — paints the `--error` modifier (rules-driven flow).
  - `string`  — paints the modifier AND becomes the inline error
    message rendered by consumers that opt-in (e.g. FileField's
    dropzone). For consumers that don't read the string, the
    truthy semantics still apply.
  - `false` / omitted — no error.

props.name: borderBlock
props.label: borderBlock
props.description:
Logical-axis shorthand for the block-start + block-end edges (top +
bottom in the default horizontal-tb writing mode). Resolves to the
native CSS `border-block-{width,style,color}` properties — same
value grammar as `borderTop` / `borderRight` / `borderBottom` /
`borderLeft` (boolean opt-in, bare width number, or a free-form
`"width style color"` string). Precedence: beats the global `border`
shorthand for the edges it targets, but a physical `borderTop` /
`borderBottom` still wins over it for that specific edge — see
`useBorder` JSDoc for the full precedence table.

props.name: borderInline
props.label: borderInline
props.description:
Logical-axis shorthand for the inline-start + inline-end edges (left
+ right in LTR). Same grammar and precedence rules as `borderBlock`,
mapped onto `border-inline-{width,style,color}`.

props.name: borderTopColor
props.label: borderTopColor
props.description:
Per-side color override (issue #215). Additive: absent by default,
no behaviour change for existing consumers.

Precedence (specific > global): `borderTopColor` wins over any
color implied by `borderTop` (e.g. `borderTop="2px dashed red"`),
which itself wins over the global `borderColor` / `border` shorthand
for the top side. See `useBorder` JSDoc for the full precedence
table.

Accepts a {@link TColor} (semantic intent, raw CSS color, or falsy
to opt out) — same input family as `color` / `bgColor`. Gradients
are NOT supported on border colors (CSS `border-color` has no
gradient form) and are silently ignored.

props.name: margin
props.label: margin
props.description:
Global shorthand. `16` → `16px`; `"4"` → the `--origam-space---4`
design rung; `"8px 16px"` → block / inline; `true` → the legacy
`--marged` class.

props.label: marginTop
props.description: Overrides `margin` and `marginBlock` for the top edge.

props.name: marginInline

props.name: padding
props.label: padding
props.description:
Global shorthand. `16` → `16px`; `"4"` → the `--origam-space---4`
design rung; `"8px 16px"` → block / inline; `true` → the legacy
`--padded` class.

props.name: paddingTop
props.label: paddingTop
props.description: Overrides `padding` and `paddingBlock` for the top edge.

props.name: paddingLeft
props.label: paddingLeft
props.description: Overrides `padding` and `paddingInline` for the left edge.

props.name: paddingBottom
props.label: paddingBottom
props.description: Overrides `padding` and `paddingBlock` for the bottom edge.

props.name: paddingRight
props.label: paddingRight
props.description: Overrides `padding` and `paddingInline` for the right edge.

props.name: paddingBlock
props.label: paddingBlock
props.description: Top + bottom. Overrides `padding`; beaten by `paddingTop` / `paddingBottom`.

props.name: paddingInline
props.label: paddingInline
props.description: Left + right. Overrides `padding`; beaten by `paddingLeft` / `paddingRight`.

props.name: rounded
props.label: rounded
props.description:
Corner-radius selector. Three modes:
 - **named variant** (`'small' | 'default' | 'large' | …`,
   cf. `ROUNDED` enum) → emits `--rounded-{name}` class so the
   component's SCSS can pick the right token rung.
 - **boolean `true`** (or empty string `''`) → emits the legacy
   `--rounded` class for components that only have a single rounded
   state (e.g. `OrigamBtn` defaulting to `radius.2xl`).
 - **CSS value** (`'4px'`, `'4px 0 4px 0'`, `100`) → emits inline
   `border-radius` declarations via `useRounded.roundedStyles`.

props.name: roundedTopRight
props.label: roundedTopRight
props.description:
Top-right corner only. Takes the same vocabulary as `rounded`
(`8`, `'8px'`, `'md'`, `'large'`, `'var(…)'`), minus `shaped` /
`shaped-invert` which are asymmetric by definition.

props.name: roundedTopLeft
props.label: roundedTopLeft
props.description: Top-left corner only. Same vocabulary as `roundedTopRight`.

props.name: roundedBottomLeft
props.label: roundedBottomLeft
props.description: Bottom-left corner only. Same vocabulary as `roundedTopRight`.

props.name: roundedBottomRight
props.label: roundedBottomRight
props.description: Bottom-right corner only. Same vocabulary as `roundedTopRight`.

props.name: fontSize
props.label: fontSize
props.description:
Font size token. Maps to `--origam-font__size---{fontSize}`
(xs · sm · md · lg · xl · 2xl · 3xl · 4xl · 5xl).
When unset, the component keeps its theme / density font-size.

props.name: fontWeight
props.label: fontWeight
props.description:
Font weight token. Maps to `--origam-font__weight---{fontWeight}`
(regular 400 · medium 500 · semibold 600 · bold 700 · extrabold 800 · black 900).
When unset, the component keeps its theme font-weight.

props.name: lineHeight
props.label: lineHeight
props.description:
Line-height token. Maps to `--origam-font__lineHeight---{lineHeight}`
(none 1 · tight 1.25 · snug 1.375 · normal 1.5 · relaxed 1.625 · loose 2).
When unset, the component keeps its theme line-height.

props.name: letterSpacing
props.label: letterSpacing
props.description:
Letter-spacing token. Maps to `--origam-font__letterSpacing---{letterSpacing}`
(tight -0.025em · normal 0em · wide 0.0094em · wider 0.0125em · widest 0.0893em).
When unset, the component keeps its theme letter-spacing.
